name: Cellframe LP migration calculation flaw
summary: LpMigration.migrate(uint256) burns old CELL/WBNB LP and pairs the returned WBNB with new CELL from its inventory at the new pair's live reserve ratio. With flash-borrowed funds the attacker depressed the new CELL price and inflated the WBNB the old pair returned, so repeated migrations drained almost all of the contract's new CELL.
notes: The attacker's sales crashed CELL to well under half its market price, so the stolen CELL is valued at its realised unit value (rule 15): 377.45 WBNB received for 914,483 CELL sold, applied to the depletion less 48 CELL of fair old-LP replacement. Financing costs and CELL transfer taxes are not netted.
Earlier migrate() calls are ordinary migrations of the callers' own LP for a few CELL each; the owner's later withdrawal of the remaining inventory is not a loss.
